declarations.name: RHTower.WeilSpectral.sum_prime_deviation_le_of_bounded_zetaQuotient
declarations.compiled_type:
RHTower.WeilSpectral.sum_prime_deviation_le_of_bounded_zetaQuotient {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : RHTower.WeilPositiveFull lam) :
  ∃ G,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G {s | 1 / 2 < s.re} ∧
      (∀ (s : ℂ),
          1 < s.re → G s = Complex.exp (-LSeries (RHTower.logZetaCoeff fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0) s)) ∧
        ∀ (x M : ℝ),
          1 / 2 ≤ x →
            (∀ (s : ℂ), x < s.re → s ≠ 1 → ‖riemannZeta s * G s‖ ≤ M) →
              ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                x < σ →
                  ∀ (P : Finset ℕ),
                    (∀ p ∈ P, Nat.Prime p) → ∑ p ∈ P, |lam p - Real.log ↑p| / Real.log ↑p * ↑p ^ (-σ) ≤ 2 * M
